systems.country_label: mobile identity prototype; mobile ID; m-ID
systems.platform: mobile application, with an offline mode planned
systems.owner: Ministry of Home Affairs, Immigration, Safety and Security (MHAISS), with UNDP
systems.tiers: prototype tested with residents at Otjimbingwe, Erongo Region; a mother or a community health worker submits a birth from a phone and the ministry receives and approves it; rollout planned for 2026 after nationwide consultations

note: The prototype is a phone application by which a mother or community health worker sends a birth to the ministry, which registers it; no registry office makes the record, so it is not of the civil class and gives no fact.
